worktree_layout: <repo>/.claude/worktrees/<ticket> (built-in Claude Code worktree tooling; one per child repo in scope)

e2e_harness.what: drive a sandboxed instance end-to-end as a human would (isolated ports/state)
e2e_harness.command: familydiagram-testing MCP bridge (real Qt app UI) with ephemeral_server=True (sandboxed Flask + SQLite)
e2e_harness.notes: Production Flask on 8888 is user-managed - never touch. Sandbox Flask on 8889 from the worktree via PYTHONPATH. Pro launched with ephemeral_server=True; Personal with server_url= the same port shares one DB.

subharnesses.pro_app: familydiagram-testing MCP launch_app(app='pro', ephemeral_server=True); get_app_state() first; headless=false for screenshots
subharnesses.backend_api: curl against sandbox Flask 8889 started from the worktree with PYTHONPATH

referee.notes: SETUP GAP carried from btcopilot config: no referee implementation exists in this project; units close evidence-based per criterion.

jira.via: REST v3, basic auth patrick@alaskafamilysystems.com + ATLASSIAN_TOKEN from ~/theapp/.env (grep|cut, never source/echo), site https://alaskafamilysystems.atlassian.net

pr_lookup: gh pr list --repo patrickkidd/familydiagram --head {branch} --state open --json url --jq '.[].url'

ci.status: gh pr checks {pr_url} --required --json state --jq 'if length==0 then error("no checks") elif all(.[]; .state=="SUCCESS") then empty else error("not green") end'
